capabilities: Schedule whole notes for spaced repetition review with FSRS or SM-2
Rate recall per note with keyboard shortcuts (Again, Hard, Good, Easy, Bury)
Filter the review queue by tag and set a daily review target
Write review due dates into note properties
Auto-fold headings so details are hidden for active recall
extras: Offers a beta installation channel via BRAT in addition to manual installation from release files; the author requests donations and GitHub stars. Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: The author built it because most study tools make you create tiny, annoying flashcards, and he wanted review to work on whole notes without extra work.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to resurface notes for review, and existing study tools require manually creating small flashcards instead of using the notes you already wrote.
summary: Spaced repetition review system that schedules whole notes for review using FSRS and SM-2 scheduling algorithms.
